minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved three wetlands filings and a Mass Trails contract, and ordered enforcement on an expired permit.
minutes.summary: The commission heard several requests and approved most of them. what_happened.line: The commission voted to issue an enforcement order on an expired permit at a property the agent described.
It approved a contract award for Mass Trails grant work to Dillon Roy, with Mass Trails paying most of the cost and the commission the rest.
It continued the Mass Ave driveway request to September 4 so the applicant can add measurements to the drawing.
It approved two requests for determination, two notices of project change and three certificates of compliance, all by unanimous roll call.
It continued the 171 Arbor Street hearing to September 18, and the agent will check whether a wetland violation exists at Meadow Lane.

why_it_matters: Wetlands filings and enforcement decide what can be built near protected land in town, and the Mass Trails work draws on commission tree funds that members described as getting lean.
The select board's vote to use ARPA funds as the match for the trails grant shows that more than one town body is paying for this work.

September 18: the 171 Arbor Street hearing resumes.
